title: chock-catalog
summary: The policy library: the manifest schema, policy folders with their evals, the generators under tools/, registry.yaml, the catalog's own compiled output, and the build route toward the plugin repos.
intro: Each policy is a folder of plain files: a manifest.yaml that chock's schema validates, an eval suite, and generated plugin files. tools/regen_all.py regenerates every derived file, including registry.yaml, and CI checks that none has drifted. chock plugin build and chock marketplace package the same folders for each client; the release check reads which catalog and engine commits each plugin repo was generated from.

boundaries.label: A policy folder, its schema and its eval replay
Derived in the catalog, checked in CI

nodes.label: Manifest schema
nodes.card: The JSON Schema chock validates a policy's manifest.yaml against. It requires id, name, version, description, artifact, enforcement, provenance and lifecycle; artifact is rule, hook, skill or workflow, and enforcement is advise, verify or block. A sibling file, eval.schema.json, describes evals/suite.yaml.

nodes.label: manifest.yaml
nodes.card: One policy's identity and payload. The cited one declares a hook.gate of kind content_regex that runs on commit and tool_use with action block, plus compliance anchors, provenance, lifecycle status and a changelog. Published policies are folders under base/, compliance/ and agentic-security/ (tools/trees.py).

nodes.label: evals/suite.yaml
nodes.card: The policy's test cases. A case with an execute: block names the files to stage and the verdict it expects, block or allow, so it can be replayed with no agent in the loop. A case without one is counted but not executed.

nodes.label: Eval replay
nodes.card: chock check --only evals runs this. Each executable case is replayed in a throwaway git repo in a temporary directory, against the policy's compiled git-hook gate.json, a gate built from the manifest when none is compiled, or the policy's guard for a command case. It reports the verdict it observed, and a case fails when that differs from the expected one.

nodes.label: tools/regen_all.py
nodes.card: Regenerates every derived file in dependency order: lib/ copies, plugin packages, chock sync, registry and README counts, then policy docs, the coverage matrix, quickstart.sh and figures. Then it runs the checks CI runs; --check-only writes nothing.

nodes.label: plugin.json + skill
nodes.card: Generated from manifest.yaml by chock plugin build, with skills/<id>/SKILL.md beside it, so each policy folder is also an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package. Its extension block records the manifest, artifact, enforcement and coverage_without_chock: advisory.

nodes.label: gen_registry.py
nodes.card: Writes registry.yaml's rows, the README's counts and the prose counts from the policies on disk. A row comes from the manifest and the eval suite's case counts. Each per-client label is graded from the hooks in packages it builds with chock plugin build --format all into a temporary directory.

nodes.label: registry.yaml
nodes.card: One generated row per published policy: path, version, artifact, enforcement, status, mechanism, enforces, eval_cases, eval_executed, and a label for claude-code, cursor, codex, copilot and devin saying what the policy does on that client.

nodes.label: .agents/policies/
nodes.card: The catalog is an adopter of its own policies: .agents/policies/ holds the subset of base/ that governs this repo. tools/check_installed.py fails when an installed copy is ahead of or differs from its source, and warns when it is behind.

nodes.label: .chock/compiled/
nodes.card: What chock sync writes for each installed policy: one subfolder per surface (git-hook, ci-gate, pre-tool-use, stop, agent-hooks, mcp-gateway, managed-setting, ambient-rule). The cited file is the commit gate for block-invisible-unicode, which the eval replay uses when it exists.

nodes.label: check_registry.py
nodes.card: Checks registry.yaml against the policies on disk: ids, paths, labels, versions, eval counts and text. CI runs it together with gen_registry.py --check --registry-only, so a stale row fails the build.

nodes.label: Release check
nodes.card: The release train's consistency check, in chock-release. Its check 5 reads generated_from.yaml in each plugin repo (chock-claude, -cursor, -codex, -copilot and -devin-plugins) and refuses unless it names the release manifest's catalog and engine commits.

nodes.label: chock marketplace
nodes.card: Writes the marketplace index over a tree built by chock plugin build: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json for claude and codex, .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json for cursor, and a root meta-plugin for devin. marketplace_repo.py adds the repo's llms.txt and issue config.

nodes.label: chock plugin build
nodes.card: Packages policy folders as plugins. Without --out-dir it writes the Agent Plugins files in place; a client format such as claude, copilot, cursor, codex or devin needs --out-dir and is written to <out-dir>/<format>/<id>/. With --check it reports stale output and writes nothing.
